name: Gelato
summary: Global print-on-demand platform: design, produce and ship custom products (apparel, wall art, mugs, photo books) locally in 30+ countries with no inventory. Integrates with Shopify, Etsy and WooCommerce.
best_for: creators and stores selling custom products internationally who want local production in many countries to cut shipping time and cost, with no inventory
skip_if: you sell only a handful of orders a month (stay on the free plan) or your customers are concentrated in one country where a single-hub competitor is simpler
honest_knock: The free plan is usable, so the honest question is only whether Gelato+ earns its fee, and that depends entirely on volume: below ~10 orders a month the discounts won't cover the subscription. Its real edge is local production in 30+ countries (fast, cheaper international shipping), but that means quality and product availability can vary slightly by region and print partner. Sample your key products before scaling.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/gelato-print-on-demand for Gelato+ and its trial, and in our own test account the same day; plan table read again 2026-09-23 on gelato.com/subscription-plans in a browser session, every figure unchanged since 26 August; the site serves a bot challenge that our capture cannot pass, so there is no dated screenshot beside this) Free is $0 forever with two connected stores and two account users. Gelato+ is $29.99 a month, or $19.99 a month billed annually, and lifts both of those to unlimited while adding Personalization Studio, the AI tools and up to 33% off products year-round. Platinum is quoted, with custom discounts, a rewards programme and a dedicated implementation service. Note where those figures live: gelato.com/pricing publishes no subscription rates at all — it explains how payment works, with no upfront fees and no commission — and the plan table sits on /subscription-plans. The rates are in dollars even read from Europe. The plan FAQ adds that the product discounts may vary per market, that monthly and annual carry identical features and discounts (annual saves $120 a year), and that Gelato+ can be cancelled anytime from the account dashboard. On the Shopify App Store listing, read 17 November 2026, Gelato+ is $29.99 a month or $239.88 a year, shown as a 33% saving, with a 14 day free trial; inside the app the trial screen says the product discounts are not applied during the trial, and offers to skip the trial to start them at once. Gelato+ pays for itself on product discounts rather than features, so the question is order volume, not which tools you want.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session first installed the Shopify app of Gelato on a development store, which sent us at once to a separate Gelato login, and then tested in the Gelato dashboard with the own Gelato our account. A Gildan 64000 T-shirt with the text Test Print reached the mockup and the Details step in about 6 minutes; Add to store needs a connected store, and a Manual store was enough. The product page showed €4.98 excl. VAT with 30% off the first order, delivery €3.99 and 4-5 business days to the Netherlands, and the shirt is made in 14 countries. The Gelato+ trial pop-up said Unlimited stores & users and that product discounts are not applied on the trial; the trial was not started, nothing was published, ordered or paid, and checkout and cancelling were not tested. Two attempts. First attempt, through the Shopify app: at 19:38 the install form of the App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/gelato-print-on-demand, English) was submitted in our own tab and the Shopify screen Install app warned that Gelato: Print on Demand does not support market-driven shipping (you can switch back to legacy shipping profiles until July 1, 2027) and asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data. After Install the app sent us in the same minute to the login of Gelato (Welcome back, with Apple, Facebook and Google or an e-mail and a password, and Dont have an account? Sign up). There was no automatic connection and no Connect button, so the app only opens with a separate Gelato account. Nothing was filled in, no account was made and the app was uninstalled afterwards (reason Testing multiple apps). Second attempt, in the Gelato dashboard with the own Gelato our account (not through the Shopify app, and the Gelato app was not installed in the development store): the dashboard was in English and showed the onboarding 3 simple steps to start selling (Connect your store, Create your first product, Order your first sample), the sidebar offer Try Gelato+ for free and a banner 30% off your first order. A first start at 20:14 was stopped at once on instruction; it was resumed at about 20:1x to 20:2x. Core action, a T-shirt with text up to the mockup, about 6 minutes and 14 steps: Create product, Single product led to Choose product with No templates here; in the Product catalog the page of the Gildan 64000 shirt has Add to store, which asks Connect your store to get started (Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, TikTok Shop, WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, BigCommerce, Manual), so a connected store is required. Manual was chosen (no outside account) with the store name Test Store typed by the tester, which made a store in Gelato. Then Create product, Single product, Bestsellers, Classic Unisex Crewneck T-shirt | Gildan 64000, and the wizard Product, Design, Details. The design editor showed a welcome pop-up (skipped), Add text was used and Test Print was typed; Continue to Details showed the mockup with Test Print on the chest, the title Classic Unisex Crewneck T-shirt | Gildan 64000 White, a description, a size table and care instructions, with Progress saved in Drafts. Nothing was published, ordered, sampled or paid and no address was entered. The draft was deleted with the menu and Delete (Yes, I want to delete product draft). Prices as shown: the product page said €4.98 excl. VAT in red, with the first order discount of 30% if placed in the next 47h 52m 14s, and delivery €3.99, 4-5 business days, Delivery to Netherlands. The catalogue said From € 8.51 excl. VAT and € 8.51 with Gelato+, and the wizard said From € 7.12 excl. VAT. The page also said No minimums, Ships in 4-5 days, 14 countries and Carbon-neutral; the shirt is made in AT, AU, CA, CZ, DE, FR, GB, IT, NL, NZ, PL, PT, SE and US (14 countries); the catalogue text said 680 products and 32 countries. No order was placed, so the real delivery time and the price at checkout were not tested. Plans: the App Store listing (read on 17 November 2026) says Free to install and Free trial available: Gelato Free (Pay for what you print; print on demand for global creators; hundreds of products to design and sell) and Gelato+ at $29.99 a month, or $239.88 a year and save 33% (up to 33% off products, exclusive tools, Magic Mockups, Instant Collections, Price Navigator, Product Migration with Velocity Switch, stock images, graphics and fonts) with a 14-day free trial; all charges are billed in USD and recurring and usage-based charges every 30 days. In the dashboard the pop-up Welcome to Gelato+! said Product discounts Not applied on trial (up to 33% off products; skip the trial to start getting discounts on your next order), Personalization Studio, AI Tools & Premium design assets, Unlimited stores & users, Cancel any time and that a reminder comes 5 days before the trial ends, with the buttons Start 14-day free trial and Skip trial and activate discounts now. Neither was clicked, because it was not known whether a card would be asked; no stored card was seen. No trial was started, nothing was approved and no Shopify approval screen was seen. Differences: the dossier says 2 stores and 2 users, the pop-up says Unlimited stores & users; the dossier says 32 countries and 250+ facilities, the listing says 140+ local production hubs in 32 countries; the dossier gives $19.99 a month billed yearly, the listing shows $239.88 a year (which is $19.99 a month) and save 33% next to $29.99 a month; the listing shows 4.8 stars and 1,044 reviews against 1,007 in the dossier. The price fields are not changed here. Checkout: NOT reached, the trial was not started and no card or payment screen was seen. Cancelling: not tested, no plan was taken; only the text Cancel any time on the trial pop-up was seen. Not tested: a real delivery or sample, publishing to a shop, Magic Mockups (Gelato+), discounts after activation, the cancel route, the plans inside the Gelato app of the Shopify store and local production beyond the list of countries. Clean up: the draft product was deleted; the empty Manual store Test Store stays in the Gelato our account and the account stays; no trial and no card. In the first attempt the app was uninstalled from the development store and nothing was created. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Shopify app only opens with a separate Gelato account (login at once after the install); Add to store needs a connected store before any product can be saved; the trial pop-up says that product discounts are not applied during the trial; and prices differ by screen (€4.98 on the product page with a first order discount, €8.51 in the catalogue, €7.12 in the wizard).
